paras: [He] is a man of great character both on a professional and personal level.  He exemplifies the qualities of a natural leader with his problem solving expertise, genuineness, intelligence, and integrity to name just a few attributes.  He has a resolute desire to exemplify and promote excellence to both his clients and his employees; which has had an extremely positive effect and brought the very best out of the people he works with and manages.  [His] commitment to providing his clients with the highest level of service while fulfilling their current needs as well as long term goals is unsurpassed!  He truly has been and continues to be an invaluable asset to [our company] and the success of our day to day operations.

I worked hand-in-hand with [him] for over 7 years on projects big and small, difficult and complex, straight forward and simple.  In each circumstance I was always assured of [his] passion to do what is right, what is technically sound, and what is cost effective.  He was a very ethical and extremely hard-working.  He was also always willing to do all tasks associated with getting the job done, from managing an outsourced company, to getting his hands dirty in doing an install.  He was thorough, prudent and very conscientious to ensure that the customers' expectations were met, and the effort was done within or below the proposed budget.  He is a team player that always gave you his full effort.  His passion to learn was always there, as he would do the up front study to ensure he was familiar with the product/system and/or proposed solution.

[He] has evolved into viewing things with a global focus, able to manage disparate groups and cultures and also results-oriented.  He was a strategic and valuable resource to me, and he would be to any effort he engages in.
cap: Worked together for more than 7 years

paras: I worked closely with [him] during my time at [the company].  He and I worked together on several projects such as integration of the various acquisitions at [the company], as well as setting up Oracle (new ERP system).  [He] is an energetic IT professional.  He is very well versed in all aspects of technologies necessary for any business to run smoothly.  Additionally, he is quite skillful in understanding business and its users' needs and marrying them to the technologies available.  He has managed very successfully the many networks [the company] has deployed, as well completing their integration as new businesses have been added.  [He] is a strong leader (often leading by example) and a great communicator!  He has a 'roll up your sleeves' approach to any task at hand, and would be a great asset to any organization!

[He] is the kind of guy all successful organizations need.  He is very intelligent, a natural leader, self-motivated, and a problem solver.  He is very upbeat, always quick to help others less capable, always offering words of support and encouragement.  He brings out the best in those around him, helping them be the best they can possibly be.  I highly recommend him and I would enjoy any opportunity to work with [him] again.
